title: Siege of Kaminogō Castle
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Kaminogō Castle", at revision 1380072278, opens: "The siege of Kaminogō Castle was a battle in 1562, during the Sengoku period of Japan. Kaminogō Castle was an Imagawa clan outpost located in eastern Aichi Prefecture, in what is now the town of Gamagōri." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7510141, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1562 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
